mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 50.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over the past 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) and retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) both decline month-over-month, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 60 and the unemployment rate (proxied by UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market and strong industrial activity that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO > 60 and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (proxied by FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI inflation rate (proxied by CPIAUCSL) is above 3%, it signals a loose monetary policy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (proxied by UNRATE) is rising and payroll employment (proxied by PAYEMS) is falling, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months when UNRATE is rising and PAYEMS is falling.
